nodes.title: A novel framework for extracting moment-based fingerprint features in specific emitter identification
nodes.methodology: Analytical investigation of intentional/unintentional modulation effects on moments. Framework involves fine-segmenting signals, calculating moments, and designing features through signal decomposition into sinewaves.
nodes.contribution: Theoretical analysis of IM/UIM mechanisms, first comprehensive framework for designing moment-based fingerprint features, and improved SEI generalization capabilities.

nodes.title: ADL-ID: Adversarial Disentanglement Learning for Wireless Device Fingerprinting Temporal Domain Adaptation
nodes.dataset: Real LoRa and WiFi datasets; 2.1TB WiFi 802.11b dataset from 50 Pycom devices over 5 days (indoor/outdoor).
nodes.methodology: ADL-ID uses adversarial disentanglement to separate device-specific (RFFs) and domain-specific features, leveraging only domain-invariant features for classification.
nodes.contribution: Proposed ADL-ID framework for temporal domain adaptation; released first large-scale WiFi 802.11b RFFP dataset for research.

nodes.title: Radio Transmitter Fingerprinting: A Steady State Frequency Domain Approach
nodes.dataset: Eight identical USRP transmitters with 1MHz bandwidth preambles at 2.4-2.5GHz, using UMTS RACH protocol for signal generation.
nodes.methodology: Combines frequency domain analysis with k-NN classifiers to extract log-spectral-energy features from steady-state signal preambles, avoiding transient analysis complexities.
nodes.contribution: Proposes steady-state frequency domain analysis with k-NN classifiers for RF fingerprinting, enabling scalable and cost-effective transmitter identification.

nodes.title: Improving Wireless Network Security Based On Radio Fingerprinting
nodes.dataset: 10 Motorola walkie-talkies for signal collection and identification.
nodes.methodology: Fractional Fourier Transform (FrFT) for transient signal feature extraction, Robust Principal Component Analysis (RPCA) for dimensionality reduction, and K-Nearest Neighbor (KNN) for classification.
nodes.contribution: Proposed a novel radio frequency fingerprint extraction method combining FrFT, RPCA, and KNN for secure wireless device identification.

nodes.dataset: Public LoRa dataset [9] and self-collected LoRa dataset with 10 devices, tested in static, mobile, LOS, and NLOS environments.
nodes.methodology: Contrastive learning with data augmentation techniques is employed to mitigate channel impacts. Spectrogram analysis and channel-independent features are leveraged for device identification.
nodes.contribution: Proposed a contrastive learning-based RFFI system with channel-robust spectrogram analysis, created a LoRa dataset for mobile scenarios, and validated performance across real-world environments.
